meta.source: Authored from scratch for Drawpane, November 2026

color.note: Two themes, Paper (light) and Graphite (dark). Warm neutrals, one accent (signal). Canvas semantics (component, guide, xray-*) are reserved for marks on the design canvas.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The infinite canvas behind the design. Never used for chrome.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes: Layers, Inspector, command strip, dashboard background.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Field wells: number fields, search, code blocks inside a pane.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Selection Lens, dialogs: anything that floats above a pane.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and control hover on surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed controls, open menu triggers, the current tab.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts: the one inverted ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between pane sections and list rows. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Pane outlines against the canvas; table borders.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: checkbox, switch track off, text inputs in forms. 3:1 on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on every surface, sunken, raised and hover ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary text, placeholders, on every surface ground (4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only. Exempt from contrast; always paired with a disabled cursor.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (tooltips, toasts).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon ink on every surface ground (3:1+).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Drawpane's one accent: primary buttons, selection on the canvas, the active tool, focus ring. At most one signal-filled control per view.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of signal-filled controls.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill. Never white: white on signal misses 4.5:1.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal used as text or a thin mark on surface grounds: links, the active tab label, counts.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row background in Layers and lists; pair with ink text.

tokens.name: component
tokens.usage: Main components and instances: layer icons, outlines and names on the canvas.

tokens.name: component-ink
tokens.usage: Component names as text in Layers and the Inspector, on surface and signal-soft.

tokens.name: component-soft
tokens.usage: Component row tint and the variant-matrix ground.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Smart guides, distance measurements and red-line specs on the canvas.

tokens.name: xray-padding
tokens.usage: Layout X-ray: padding areas, drawn at 35% opacity over the design. Same in both themes, because it sits on the design, not the chrome.

tokens.name: xray-gap
tokens.usage: Layout X-ray: gap areas between flex or grid children, at 35% opacity.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text: saved, published, merged. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon and text: detached token, missing font. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors as text, icons and outlines.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button; text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational icon and text: tips, branch notices.

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: Multiplayer cursor, name tag and avatar ring for collaborator 1. Presence never uses signal, which is reserved for your own selection.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Collaborator 2.

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Collaborator 3.

tokens.name: presence-4
tokens.usage: Collaborator 4.

tokens.name: presence-5
tokens.usage: Collaborator 5.

tokens.name: presence-6
tokens.usage: Collaborator 6.

tokens.name: presence-7
tokens.usage: Collaborator 7.

tokens.name: presence-8
tokens.usage: Collaborator 8 and overflow.

tokens.name: on-presence
tokens.usage: Text on a presence fill: collaborator name tags on the canvas.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: AI agents in the room: agent cursor, name tag, dashed selection outline and the agent pane accent. Never used for people.

tokens.name: agent-ink
tokens.usage: Agent names, status and links as text on surface, surface-raised and agent-soft.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Agent step rows, proposal cards and the running-step highlight; pair with ink text.

tokens.name: on-agent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an agent fill, such as an agent's name tag.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Field labels and section captions in panes. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Default text in panes: layer names, menu items, field values (with tabular figures).

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Inspector section titles, selected layer names, button labels.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: File name in the title strip, popover and menu headings.

styles.name: page-body
styles.sample: Files you edited in the last 30 days.
styles.usage: Dashboard, settings and onboarding body copy.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Empty states and onboarding headlines. Never inside the editor chrome.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inspect panel CSS, token names in specs, the command bar's typed syntax.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcuts in menus, tooltips and key caps.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Names are the multiple of 4 times 100, so space-300 = 12px.

tokens.name: space-050
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge inside dense controls; token chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between stacked fields in a property row.

tokens.name: space-200
tokens.usage: Control inner padding; gap between controls in a row; Layers indent per level is 12px (space-300).

tokens.name: space-300
tokens.usage: Pane horizontal padding; Layers indent per nesting level.

tokens.name: space-400
tokens.usage: Gap between Inspector sections; dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-500
tokens.usage: Dashboard card padding.

tokens.name: space-600
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-800
tokens.usage: Section spacing on dashboard and settings pages.

tokens.name: space-1200
tokens.usage: Empty-state and marketing block spacing.

radius.note: Small, crisp radii: Drawpane is a precision tool. Panes are the roundest thing in the UI.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Token chips, key caps, checkboxes, color swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, menu items, layer rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Selection Lens, tooltips, dashboard file cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating panes (Layers, Inspector, command strip) and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, presence dots, switch tracks.

shadow.note: Elevation is a hairline ring plus one soft shadow. Panes float over the canvas; nothing inside a pane casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Floating panes over the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Selection Lens, the command bar.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs over a scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 1px ground gap, then a solid 2px signal ring. Apply on :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Inspector fields, icon buttons in panes, segmented controls.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, command strip tools, layer rows.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Dashboard and dialog buttons, the command bar input.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: All UI icons, drawn on a 16px grid.

tokens.name: size-pane
tokens.usage: Default width of the Layers and Inspector panes (resizable 224 to 400).

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Width of a pane collapsed to its icon rail.
